hover_power_w.notes: hover_power_w = battery_wh / no_payload_endurance_hours. The stored value implies roughly 20 minutes of endurance, which matches the published figure at a 20 lb load rather than the no-payload figure the formula names (published: about 41.7 minutes at 5 lb). The number is therefore conservative -- it overstates draw, which understates endurance -- and is left as-is rather than lowered on the strength of a search summary. A flight log settles it.
